name: Cambridge-style B1 Preliminary (Writing)
description: Four criteria scored 0-5 with B1 expectations, modelled on the public structure of the B1 Preliminary writing assessment.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.description: All content is relevant to the task and the reader is fully informed; every point asked for is covered.

criteria.name: Communicative Achievement
criteria.description: Uses the conventions of the task type (email, article, story) to hold the reader's attention and communicate straightforward ideas.

criteria.name: Organisation
criteria.description: Text is generally well organised and coherent, using a variety of linking words and some cohesive devices.

criteria.name: Language
criteria.description: Uses a range of everyday vocabulary appropriately, with some less common words, and a range of simple and some complex grammatical forms with a good degree of control; errors do not impede communication.
